independentAnswerDerivation.method: Read the fourteen stems and choices with authored keys and explanations omitted. Inspected the actual current objective map, raw MCP technical bodies and link/reference receipts, derived each answer, then compared the stored key and every authored explanation. Rationales and check decisions were written in this context. Only exact hashes, source snapshot fields, identities and timestamps were bound mechanically.
independentAnswerDerivation.limitation: Key agreement is not candidate approval: four exact records remain held for separately identified explanation or quality defects.

holds.finding: The key is technically correct, but a asks to enable an already enabled setting a second time; b asserts expiry even though reads are within TTL; and c conflicts with both the documented in-memory tier and already working REST L1. holds.repairNeeded: Replace the self-contradictory alternatives with plausible, source-backed cache diagnoses. Re-evaluate the resulting reasoning depth. Do not simply retain this review after changing options.
holds.restartRequired: Grounded generation, fresh independent technical review, and a distinct adversarial review.

provenanceReview.method: Inspected the current guide, credential and course MCP bodies; credential HTML's course.dp-800t00 UID; course HTML's secure-path UID; the matching secure-path canonical HTML/UID; the path's module link; the module's unit links; and each cited technical article's immediate training link or explicit reference. Technical bodies were read from the actual saved Microsoft Learn MCP receipts, not the author's short summaries.
provenanceReview.canonicalReference: The summary's observed reference-configuration?azure-portal=true reference is preserved. The query-free transport receipt at 2026-09-16T20:07:34.641Z records status 200 and resolution to configuration/. The subsequent canonical MCP retrieval is 2026-09-16T20:08:08.292Z, preceding the frozen source review. No doc-to-doc link is used as provenance.
provenanceReview.approvalBoundary: These thirteen sources and their necessary ancestry are suitable for the specific reviewed claims, subject to the four candidate holds. Other curated source proposals were not semantically approved. The course remains ancestry-only; no course, quiz, assessment, video, blog or unrelated official document supplies option evidence.
provenanceReview.structuralAllowlistMethod: For scoped structural testing only, cloned the DP-800 credential in memory and unioned exact URLs from the shared root manifest and this author's actual source manifest. No host or directory wildcard, source timestamp edit, alternate credential approval or persistent catalog change was made. Full shared roots and every ancestor of the cited sources were retained.
provenanceReview.freshnessBoundary: Source retrieval/review timestamps remain frozen. This pass inspects the September 16 stored evidence and recorded canonical receipts; it does not claim a new online availability check or permanently current documentation.

sourceCautions.finding: Its GraphQL caching text conflicts with the directly linked current L1 product article. Mapping, filter, cursor and routing passages were evaluated separately. No blanket technical approval of the whole unit or its REST-method/GraphQL-operation snippets is supplied.

The product procedure article, not the teaching unit's sample method/parameter syntax or multiple-result-set wording, controls the reviewed procedure default. View row identity and directional relationships are separate evaluated claims.

The review does not endorse complete automatic instrumentation from a connection string alone, automatic operation-ID propagation into arbitrary logs, or every alert example. Question 043 explicitly supplies existing spans; question 044 supplies existing ingested records.

Used as observed immediate provenance for CDC/CES, not as authority for its CES setup syntax, unlabeled lifecycle, immediate-delivery or throughput claims. Current CES product evidence explicitly remains Preview and notes AMQP deprecation.
The sample's anonymous:* permission and latest image tag are not production recommendations. The reviewed candidate requires its own approved immutable image and controlled runtime secret handling.

duplicatesAndQuality.scope: Independently compared all fourteen stems/options and fact-level concepts with one another, the two retained installed canonical items, and thirteen relevant unique archived integration candidates. Existing duplicateFindings and qualityFindings were also executed on the scoped records.
duplicatesAndQuality.answerPositionAssessment: The twelve single-answer keys occupy a:4, b:3, c:1, d:4. Including both two-answer items gives a:5, b:4, c:2, d:5. This small scope has no deterministic >55% position warning; no key position was changed. No answer-length warning occurred. Semantic clues were nevertheless found in 036.
reasoningDistinctions: 019 locates connection ownership; 035 reconciles schema and executable versions; 038 composes global and entity API paths.
036 tests REST-only cache applicability, whereas archived 056 tests missing entity opt-in and 057 tests TTL inheritance.
039 supplies view result identity; 040 sets directional foreign-key traversal; archived 055 instead moves related entities into one configuration file.
041 supplies missing deployed configuration/environment inputs; 042 seeks independent evidence of the post-deployment data path.
043 selects per-transaction timing evidence; 044 diagnoses resource-versus-workspace query scope.
045 tests replication/CDC reader reuse, not archived capture latency, capture-instance schema, operation codes or retention-window failure.
046 distinguishes Managed Instance update policy and CES Preview status; no comparable archived CES-policy question was found.
nonblockingCautions: 046's calendar-based GA alternative is weak; the other platform/maturity alternatives still test real documented distinctions. The adversarial context should independently assess their plausibility.

045's Advanced classification rests on shared replication/CDC internals and intentional job absence, not merely the presence of a long scenario. The third context must score that judgment independently.
duplicatesAndQuality.limitation: This is not a full cross-credential semantic duplicate audit. No schema or deterministic heuristic is represented as proof of originality, accuracy or reviewer independence.

executionLimits.staticOnly: Inspected configuration and GraphQL fragments and documented SQL/platform behavior. No database, DAB runtime, container, monitoring workspace or cloud deployment was executed or modified.
executionLimits.noNewSourceClaims: No new source retrieval date, source review date, live availability result or MCP response was invented.
executionLimits.nextContext: A distinct adversarial reviewer must challenge every option and independently score the strict rubric. Held authored fields require fresh generation and a new technical pass before a successful final review; these holds cannot be overridden by copying a new outer version label.
